techniques.name: none
techniques.description: No retrieval: the model answers from what it learned in training.

techniques.name: dense
techniques.description: Dense retrieval: the 2 paragraphs most similar to the question (bge-m3).

techniques.name: dense_with_reranker
techniques.description: Dense retrieval of 12 candidates, then an LLM picks the 2 most helpful.

techniques.name: gpt-oss-20b
techniques.description: GPT-OSS 20B (OpenAI open-weight, mixture of experts) writes the answer.

techniques.name: gpt-oss-120b
techniques.description: GPT-OSS 120B (OpenAI open-weight, mixture of experts) writes the answer.

techniques.name: on
techniques.description: Does nothing: returns the answer unchanged.

techniques.name: off
techniques.description: Does nothing either. The true effect is zero, so CAFE must find this factor non-significant.

techniques.name: plain
techniques.description: A bare support assistant, without the handbook.

techniques.name: with_support_handbook
techniques.description: The same assistant plus the company's support handbook (its procedures).

techniques.name: gpt-oss-20b
techniques.description: GPT-OSS 20B (OpenAI open-weight, mixture of experts) writes the reply.

techniques.name: gpt-oss-120b
techniques.description: GPT-OSS 120B (OpenAI open-weight, mixture of experts) writes the reply.

techniques.name: deepseek-v4-pro
techniques.description: DeepSeek-V4-Pro (a large mixture-of-experts model) writes the reply.
